scientific_note: The reflectance16 release stores surface reflectance multiplied by 10000. Divide by 10000 for model inputs and metrics on linear reflectance.
split_scope: Whole 100-km block identifiers are assigned to one split. Source-product reuse and 22 test footprints intersecting another partition are documented in the audits.
training_loss_mask: Intersection of all-band TIFF raster masks: nearest-neighbour 3x expansion of LR mask and HR mask, broadcast over output channels. All-valid released TIFF masks yield full-frame L1. QA/SCL and companion identified-fill masks are separate from loss support.
evaluation_support: Linear reflectance, three-pixel HR border exclusion and joint TIFF raster masks. Companion identified-fill masks are supporting audit artifacts.
annotation_scope: Landscape sampling strata use Esri 2025 annual land-cover percentages and Copernicus DEM GLO-30 descriptors.
